user.title: WhatsMiner API 3.x
user.description: Direct local connection. Setup reads telemetry only. API 2.x on port 4028 is not supported. Select Submit to continue to API power control and web settings when enabled.

control.title: Power control
control.description: Enter limits appropriate for your exact model. Enable API Write in WhatsminerTool. Use super or user1–user3. Setup does not test credentials with a write command. This is the password for the selected API account, separate from web login credentials.

web.title: Individual chip web data
web.description: Read the LuCI btminerapi syslog page or a normalized JSON endpoint. The default path uses HTTPS on port 443. LuCI authentication uses separate web credentials and renews the session when needed. Leave JSON Pointer blank for HTML or text. Certificate verification is enabled by default; disable it only for a trusted local miner with a self-signed certificate. Blank secret fields preserve existing values.

data.web_json_pointer: JSON Pointer to the boards container (blank = root)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read API 3.x. Check host, port 4433, firmware and connectivity.
error.different_device: Different miner at this address. Add it as a separate device.
error.invalid_web_endpoint: Enter a relative path /… and a JSON Pointer /… or blank.
error.web_credentials_required: Provide credentials for the selected WEB authentication method.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: This is the first settings step. Select Submit to edit API account/password and power limits when power control is enabled, then web authentication when chip data is enabled. Settings are saved only after the final step.

control.title: Power control
control.description: Enter the password for the selected API account (super or user1-user3). These are separate from web login credentials. A blank password keeps the stored value. Select Submit to continue to web settings when enabled; changes are saved only after the final step. Saving does not issue power commands.
